verdict: Organic channels are declining sharply; no paid leads were generated this period.
narrative: In the last 28 days, all activity came from organic sources — paid advertising on Meta and Google ran no spend and produced no leads. Your Google Business Profile drove 93 total actions (20 calls, 29 direction requests, 44 website clicks), but GBP activity has dropped 40% week-over-week, and the most recent three days showed zero actions — a steeper decline that is being treated as urgent. Instagram reach fell 38% over the same period, compounding the visibility concern across organic channels. Reactivating paid advertising is in motion to rebuild a reliable lead pipeline and reduce dependence on organic visibility alone.
